# requires: transfer
#
# The two endings a failed transfer can have, and the difference between them is
# the whole of it: a refusal nobody will ever satisfy must end the job, and a
# source that merely was not there must leave it adoptable. Get this backwards
# in either direction and the store either re-fetches a 404 forever or gives up
# on a NAS that had rebooted.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=nofetcher
run A alpha
orphans
submit B size=64 digest=good src=missing
run B beta
orphans
submit C size=64 digest=bad src=file
run C gamma
orphans
state A
state B
state C

# expect 2: transfer-failed state=failed [DL-E4]
# expect 3: ok - [DL-E2]
# expect 5: transfer-failed state=pending [DL-E5]
# expect 5: err=set [DL-E1]
# expect 6: ok B
# expect 8: transfer-failed state=pending [DL-R16]
# expect 8: done=0 err=set [DL-R15]
# expect 9: ok B C
# expect 10: state=failed
# expect 11: state=pending
# expect 12: state=pending
